output.answer_markdown: The filings do not support the premise of the question: Meta did not sell Instagram in 2022. The passages describe FTC litigation seeking divestiture of Instagram and WhatsApp, which is only a requested remedy [2]. Meta's 10-K also states that no goodwill impairment had been identified as of December 31, 2022 [1]. The material has no goodwill impairment figure tied to an Instagram sale.

The FTC and attorneys general complaints sought divestiture or reconstruction of Instagram and WhatsApp as a remedy.

refusal.reason: The filings show no sale of Instagram in 2022 and no goodwill impairment associated with one.
